name: Iran (Standard 2800, 4th edition, and the National Building Regulations)
description: Iran's seismic standard and building regulations (alpha 9 track C24), a pack that extends the US pack aci318-asce7-22. Seismic by Standard 2800 (4th edition): the design base acceleration A of the zone (0.35 very high, 0.30 high, 0.25 moderate, 0.20 low), the soil types I-IV with the reflection factor B = B1 N (B1 by T0, Ts, S0, S; N rising from Ts to 4 s, 1.7 in the very high and high zones, 1.4 in the moderate and low ones: two site classes per soil type), the importance factor I = 0.8-1.4, C = A B I / Ru at least 0.12 A I, the behaviour factor Ru, Ω0 and Cd of the systems, T = 0.05 H^0.9 (RC moment frames), 0.08 H^0.75 (steel moment frames), 0.05 H^0.75 (others), the drift limit with Cd times the design displacements, by the generic shapeFactors spectrum method. Concrete by INBC Part 9 (the material resistance factors φc = 0.65 and φs = 0.85 on fc and fy, the block α1 φc fc over β1 c, as the Canadian method of the pack canada-nbcc); the shear, detailing and the rest of the concrete rules and the steel design (INBC Part 10, AISC 360 type) are the base pack's ACI 318-19 and AISC 360-22. Loads (INBC Part 6) are the base pack's ASCE 7-22 combinations and live loads; the towns' wind speeds are placeholders. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the towns' zones, the soil parameters and the system factors are uncertain and must be checked before design.
